# victoriametricscloud_deployment_notifier (Resource)

Attaches a notifier (custom or cloud Alertmanager) to a VictoriaMetrics Cloud deployment. One deployment has at most one notifier attached.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) ID of the deployment the notifier is attached to.
- `notifier` (Attributes) The notifier to attach: the full output of a victoriametricscloud_custom_alertmanager or victoriametricscloud_cloud_alertmanager resource. Only its id and type attributes are used; the resource's other attributes are ignored. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notifier))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of this attachment. Equal to deployment_id.
- `notifier_name` (String) Name of the attached notifier, as reported by the API.

<a id="nestedatt--notifier"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifier`

Required:

- `id` (String) ID of the notifier.
- `type` (String) Type of the notifier: 'custom-alertmanager' or 'cloud-alertmanager'.
